besideDaemon: the beside-daemon case starts Node's daemon (src/standalone/daemon.mjs, MIXDOG_DAEMON_SPAWNED_FOR=session) on the case's data and temp folders, with an unpacked PostgreSQL runtime laid out in <data>/runtime as an installed one is (active-version and the digest stamp that runtime-fetcher.mjs cachedRuntimeDir, :494 and :675, accepts) so it downloads none; the daemon's own network is not tapped and not recorded; the recording keeps whether the daemon still answers a client registering once the exec has ended

exclusions.chunking: consecutive chunks of one stream are joined: the size of one pipe read depends on the OS, only the order of the streams is a fact of the process
exclusions.others (core only): models.dev catalog: the core fetches the models.dev and GitHub model catalogs at start (the stand-in's certificate covers neither host, so the connect is the record); Node's exec does not
exclusions.others (core only): provider cost report: the core reads the provider's cost report at start; Node's exec does not
exclusions.others (node only): tool binary download: Node fetches its three tool binaries (graph, patch, spawn) on first use and tries to download the memory runtime for its session ingest; the core ships its tools natively and downloads nothing here
exclusions.stderr (core only): goal recovery line: the core logs its boot-time goal recovery summary to the exec's stderr; Node's exec keeps its daemon log in a file
exclusions.stderr (core only): lifecycle not bound: the exec composes its in-process core without the serving lifecycle that `serve` binds, so the core logs its startup-bug line for each request (compose.rs request_started); Node's exec writes nothing of the kind
exclusions.stderr (core only): model catalog fetch: the core fetches the models.dev and GitHub catalogs (the others it makes that Node's exec does not) and logs the stand-in's refusal
exclusions.stderr (node only): ask error diagnostic: Node logs the failed ask a second time in its diagnostic form, beside the `mixdog: ` line the exec writes
exclusions.stderr (node only): lock wait diagnostic: Node logs a wait on its own session-summary lock file; the wait is a timing fact of its file layer
exclusions.stderr (node only): model listing diagno: Node logs its background model listing that the stand-in answers 404; the core writes no such line, and its place follows a background timer
exclusions.stderr (node only): node process warning: Node writes its own process warning for the built-in SQLite module; no other runtime has the module
exclusions.stderr (node only): node warning hint: the second line of the same Node process warning
exclusions.stderr (node only): session ingest diagn: after the answer Node's exec ingests its session into the memory runtime, which it tries to download (the stand-in answers 404), and logs the failure if the process is still alive to; whether the line is written before the process ends follows timing
exclusions.stderr (node only): titling diagnostic: Node logs its background session titling (start, disabled, generated); its place follows a background timer
